case_number: 2025 INSC 141; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO._______/2025 [@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO.1136/2023]
summary: Bail granted due to illegal arrest; LOC execution by Bureau of Immigration on 04.03.2022; physical custody taken by ED at 11:00 on 05.03.2022; arrest memo dated 01:15 on 06.03.2022; failure to produce before magistrate within 24 hours from 11:00 on 05.03.2022; violation of Article 22(2) and Section 57 Cr.P.C; arrest vitiated; bail not denied despite twin tests under PMLA Section 45(1)(ii); appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.4
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court bail order upheld.
